title: SevenZipCompressionConfig
description: Schema defining runtime configuration for 7z archive creation with zero-config auto-tuning

outputPath.description: Absolute filesystem path for the output .7z archive file

inputPaths.description: Array of absolute source file/directory paths to include

blockSizeBytes.description: Dynamically calculated LZMA2 block size in bytes (256KB..32MB)

dictionarySizeBytes.description: Dynamically selected dictionary size in bytes (4KB..32MB)

threadCount.description: Dynamically detected physical/logical CPU core allocation

isEntropyStoreBypass.description: Flag indicating whether high entropy (H > 7.90) triggered Store mode
